title: Set who may use PIM Manager
purpose: Sets who may use PIM Manager and at what level (Reader, Admin, SuperAdmin or Delegated) by writing the ManagerAccess setting in the environment's store: it merges with what is stored, refuses a model with no SuperAdmin, and reads the result back.
whenToRun: To give the first SuperAdmin access to a new environment, or to add, change or (with -Replace) remove Manager users when the Manager itself cannot be used for it. PIM Manager names this script when nobody has access yet.

runAs.name: Member of the environment's SQL admin group (grp-pim-sql-admins), signed in through the browser or the Invardia Support app session (no Azure CLI)
runAs.why: The access model lives in pim.Settings; only the SQL admin group may write it. With -UseSignedInAccount the signed-in az user is used (asserted to be a user in -TenantId). Alternatively the admin application's certificate (-AdminAppId + -AdminCertThumbprint).

changes.object: pim.Settings row 'ManagerAccess' (the list of identity = role entries: Reader, Admin, SuperAdmin, Delegated)
changes.why: Decides who may use PIM Manager and at what level. Merged with what is stored, keyed on identity; -Replace drops entries that are not in the input. A model with no SuperAdmin is refused unless -AllowNoSuperAdmin.
changes.undo: Run the script again with the previous entries (and -Replace to drop what was added).

changes.object: the result file named by -OutFile (ok, reason, installed / replaced / removed identities)
changes.why: For a caller that runs the script unattended and reads the outcome.

parameters.name: UseSignedInAccount
parameters.help: Reach the store as the signed-in az user (a member of the SQL admin group). The recommended way.

parameters.name: AdminAppId
parameters.help: Automation: the admin application's client id (with -AdminCertThumbprint) instead of -UseSignedInAccount.

parameters.name: AdminCertThumbprint
parameters.help: Automation: the thumbprint of the admin application's certificate in the local machine store.

parameters.name: AdminSecret
parameters.help: Legacy automation only: a client secret for -AdminAppId. Not for customer use; prefer -UseSignedInAccount.

parameters.name: AccessJson
parameters.help: A JSON file path or raw JSON: { "managerAccess": [ { "identity": "<UPN, object id or group>", "role": "Reader|Admin|SuperAdmin|Delegated" } ] }.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.help: Replace the stored list instead of merging; the entries it drops are listed first.

parameters.name: AllowNoSuperAdmin
parameters.help: Allow a model with no SuperAdmin (only when the container settings still carry one).

parameters.name: OutFile
parameters.help: Write the outcome as JSON to this file.

readsOnly: pim.Settings 'ManagerAccess' (the stored model; a read failure stops the script)
pim.Settings 'License' (only when a NEW Delegated user is added -- scoped Manager users need a Pro licence)
whatIf: Validates the input, reads the stored model, prints the resulting model (entries, SuperAdmin count, what -Replace would remove) and 'What if: Performing the operation "write N entr(y/ies): <identity>=<role>, ..." on target "pim.Settings['ManagerAccess'] in <server>/<database>"', then stops: nothing is written.
undo: Run the script again with the previous list and -Replace. The previous list is printed as 'already stored' at the start of every run.
